nodes.name: cJSON.h
nodes.summary: Vendored cJSON 1.7.18 library header defining the core JSON node structure, type constants, memory hook typedefs, and the full public API (~60 function declarations) for parsing, serializing, and manipulating JSON trees on embedded targets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a CJSON_PUBLIC(type) macro to handle __declspec(dllexport/import) on Windows and GCC visibility attributes on POSIX, enabling the same header to be used for both shared-library and static builds.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_agent.h
nodes.summary: Agent loop interface header that defines the tool-handler callback typedef, agent configuration struct (LLM config, system prompt, tool JSON, handler, max iterations), and the single-turn entry point wiz_claw_agent_run() which drives the LLM → tool-call → re-invoke loop.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_llm.h
nodes.summary: LLM client interface header for an OpenAI-compatible chat API, declaring the HTTP POST callback typedef, tool-call and response structs, client configuration struct, the wiz_claw_llm_chat() function, and conversation-history session helpers (create, append user/assistant/tool messages).
